content: Kisalu kya Pholu ku Tesalonika
Luzayibwa mboti benu-benu baphangi: kukwisa kwetu kwena benu kukadikiku kwa khatu.

Kaasi luzayibwa ni, theti bátunyokuna amana bátutukwana kuna mbanza ya Fidiphu. Kaasi twázonza yi kikumbwala mwena Nzambi wetu mu kulusamwana Musamu wa Bukheti wa Nzambi mbatanana kwákala lawu dya mizingu
Mukuma, kikesa kyetu kitukiku mu sunga dya kulutotisa, kondilo mu mambu ma mvindu, keti mu kuhuna.

Kaasi kikuma Nzambi wisi tutesa amana wututambwasini kikuma kya kutuheka kiyeka kya Musamu wa Bukheti, tubatiku sanda kikuma kya kusephidisa batu, kaasi kikuma kya kusephidisa Nzambi wuna wisi tesa mbundu zetu.
Kikuma, luzayibwa bukheti ni khaniku tuzonza yi lengu ndinga kikuma kya kuhuna batu, amana twákalaku keti sunga dya mbongu, Nzambi kenina mbangi wetu.
Tusandikiku lukumu luna lwisi tuka kwena batu, keti kwena benu keti kwena batu bahika.
Amana bwosu thwenina bathumwa ba Kidisitu, twakhana lulomba benu mu kunata kizitu kyenu. Kaasi betu twádikulumuna kwetu twakadini hana kati dya benu, hanga buna kisi tsasa ngudi bana ba yandi-meni.
Twázola muna kyesi kyetu kikuma kya benu, tuluhekaku lwesi Musamu wa Bukheti wa Nzambi, kaasi yi luzingu lwa betu-betu phi, kikuma lwákituka batondama betu.
Kikuma, baphangi, yubukenu lombu dyetu yi kulembwa kwa lutu kwetu: tusadikini phipha yi mwini, amana tubwisikini mu kuyekamina kwena mosi wa benu, yibwabuna tululongikini Musamu wa Bukheti wa Nzambi.
Bambangi lwenina benu-benu yi Nzambi phi: tudyatidikini ku thwala ya benu lwisi kwikila mu mutindu watoma, buna bufwani, amana bakonda kifu.
Luzayibwa phi ni tukadikini kikuma kya kosu mutu wa benu bwosu kenina tata kwena bana bandi.
Tuluhekikini ndongisila yi kikesa, amana tulusikidikisini mu kudyatila muna mutindu wuna wufwani wa Nzambi, yandi wuna wálutela mu kukota muna Kipfumu kyandi yi muna khembu yandi.

Amana kikuma kya bwabuna betu phi, tuvutudini matondu kwena Nzambi konda kulembwa: mu tangwa twaluyukisini Ndinga ya Nzambi lwatambwasaya, amana lwátambwasiyoku hanga ndinga yimosi ya kimutu kaasi hanga Ndinga ya Nzambi, yenina kyedika; amana yibwabuna yisi sala mwena benu bakwikidi.

Kikuma, baphangi, benu-benu lwásokulula mbandu ya Mabundu ma Nzambi mana menina mu Yuteya amana misi kwikila mwena Kidisitu Yesu. Lwányokuka kwena biwutu byenu bya tsi mosi, bwosu mányokuka Mabundu mana kwena Bayuta
Bawu báhonda Pfumu Yesu yi bambikudi, amana bawu bátunyokuna. Bisiku sephidisa Nzambi amana bawu benina bambeni ba batu boosu.
Bisi tukakidikisa mu kuzonza kwena batu bakondi kala Bayuta hanga bahuluka nana. Amana muna bwabuna bisiku lembwa mu kubasisaka mu masumu ma bawu. Kaasi tsuka-tsuka khabu za Nzambi zábabwila.
Pholu wuzodini kamona hika Batesalonika
Kwena betu, baphangi, kunima dya kudihambula yi benu mu tangwa dimosi, kyana ku mesu kaasi ka ku mbundu ku, yi lawu dya nzoluka yina twákadi yawu, twahangi mutindu wosu kikuma kya kulumona.
Tuzodikini thwisa mbala za lawu mu kulukinda, yi meni-meni Pholu, kaasi Satana wátukakidikisa.
Nati si wenina kivuvu kyetu, kyesi kyetu, mukhonzi wetu wa lulendu? Ka benu ku phi, ku mesu ma Pfumu wetu Yesu kilumbu kakwisa?
Eeh, benu lwenina khembu yetu yi kyesi kyetu.
